description: This file declares interfaces and data structures related to hardware input capture for digital inputs, including functions for starting/stopping input drivers and managing hardware pins.

classes.name: digital_input_s
classes.description: Structure representing hardware input capture configuration and status, including driver reference, active level, state, associated pin, and listeners.

methods.name: turnOnCapturePin
methods.description: Logs or handles enabling the capture pin with a message and the specific hardware pin.

methods.name: addWaveAnalyzerDriver
methods.description: Adds a wave analyzer driver for a specified pin.

methods.name: startInputDriver
methods.description: Starts the input driver with the specified hardware configuration and active level.

methods.name: removeWaveAnalyzerDriver
methods.description: Removes the wave analyzer driver from a specified hardware pin.

methods.name: getInputCaptureDriver
methods.description: Retrieves the input capture driver associated with the specified hardware pin.

methods.name: getInputCaptureChannel
methods.description: Gets the input capture channel corresponding to the specified hardware pin.
